definition.def: If something poses a problem or a danger, it is the cause of that problem or danger.
examples: This could pose a threat to jobs in the coal industry. [VERB noun]
His ill health poses serious problems for the future. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If you pose a question, you ask it. If you pose an issue that needs considering, you mention the issue. [formal]
examples: When I finally posed the question, 'Why?' he merely shrugged. [VERB noun]
...the moral issues posed by new technologies. [VERB-ed]

definition.def: If you pose as someone, you pretend to be that person in order to deceive people.
examples: Industrial spies posed as flight attendants. [VERB + as]

definition.def: If you pose for a photograph or painting, you stay in a particular position so that someone can photograph you or paint you.
examples: Before going into their meeting the six foreign ministers posed for photographs. [VERB + for]

definition.def: You can say that people are posing when you think that they are behaving in an insincere or exaggerated way because they want to make a particular impression on other people. [disapproval]
examples: He criticized them for dressing outrageously and posing pretentiously. [VERB]

definition.def: A pose is a particular way that you stand, sit, or lie, for example when you are being photographed or painted.
examples: We have had several preliminary sittings in various poses.

definition.def: A pose is an insincere or exaggerated way of behaving that is intended to make a particular impression on other people. [disapproval]
examples: In many writers modesty is a pose, but in Ford it seems to have been genuine.

examples.sentence: One form of pollution - the release of greenhouse gases that causes global warming - does appear to be a phenomenon that is going to extend well into our future, but its total impact is unlikely to pose a devastating problem.
The continuous and reckless use of synthetic chemicals for the control of pests which pose a threat to agricultural crops and human health is proving to be counter-productive.
And local farmers also pose a threat to these birds.
